description: We are 212NovaCode, a team of Software Engineers & Data Scientists building a data-driven web app. We have backend & data analysis covered. So we are looking for creative minds !!
summary:
SARdance is an interactive geospatial and AI platform designed to automate the detection, analysis, and visualization of Earth's surface deformations using multi-temporal radar data from the NASA-ISRO NISAR mission. While satellite radar interferometry (InSAR) offers powerful insights into ground displacement, processing these complex datasets typically requires advanced expertise in signal processing and geospatial science.
SARdance makes this accessible through an on-demand workflow: users simply select a custom region of interest on the map and define a start and end date. From there, the magic begins—our pipeline automatically queries the NASA Earthdata and ASF APIs to fetch the required NISAR Geocoded Unwrapped Interferogram (GUNW) products, executes quality control and coherence filtering, and runs Machine Learning (Random Forest) and Deep Learning (U-Net) models to process the data. Validated on the June 2026 Venezuela earthquake (Track 162), the platform renders the user's customized area alongside an interactive filter displaying model segmentation results and the predicted probability of each deformation event. This transforms raw radar observations into immediate, actionable insights.
details:
Overview & The Challenge

The Earth's surface continually transforms due to natural phenomena and human activities. Earthquakes, in particular, cause ground deformations that are difficult to observe and characterize at a large scale. Despite advances in remote sensing, exploiting satellite Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data remains complex and requires specialized skills in signal processing, geospatial analysis, and scientific interpretation. SARdance AI solves this by automating the ingestion, processing, and AI analysis of multi-temporal NASA-ISRO NISAR radar data, making surface deformation insights accessible to everyone through an interactive platform.

How It Works (End-to-End User & AI Pipeline)

  1. Custom Location & Date Selection: Users interactively select and customize any target area on the map and define a specific start date and end date for analysis.
    • Unwrapped Phase: Interferometric phase information directly linked to ground displacement.
    • Coherence Magnitude: Indicator of correlation quality between radar acquisitions.
    • Connected Components: Spatial continuity control for the phase unwrapping process.
  2. Side-by-Side Visualization & Probability Filter: In the final view, the platform renders the user's customized geographic area right next to an interactive results filter. Users can toggle radar layers, inspect AI-segmented deformation zones, and view the calculated probability of each detected event.

Innovation & Impact

SARdance AI's originality lies in combining on-demand user customization, automated NASA API data retrieval, rigorous InSAR quality control, AI anomaly detection, and probability-based visual filtering in a single platform. It transforms complex radar signals into clear, interpretable geospatial insights. (Note: The system serves as a scientific exploration and analysis tool, rather than a certified earthquake forecasting or disaster early-warning system.)
